# skycloak_domain (Resource)

A custom domain on a Skycloak cluster. After apply, create the returned `dns_records` at your DNS provider; verification then completes out of band (refresh to observe `verification_status`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skycloak_domain" "app" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  domain     = "auth.example.com"
}

# Create these DNS records at your provider to verify + route the domain.
output "dns_records" {
  value = skycloak_domain.app.dns_records
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.
- `domain` (String) Fully-qualified domain name. Immutable.

### Optional

- `subdomain` (String) Optional subdomain. Immutable.

### Read-Only

- `cname_target` (String) CNAME target to point the domain at.
- `created_at` (String)
- `dns_records` (Attributes List) DNS records to create for verification/routing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_records))
- `id` (String) Domain ID (UUID).
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the domain is active.
- `ssl_status` (String) SSL provisioning status.
- `updated_at` (String)
- `verification_status` (String) DNS verification status.
